name: BJFOOD
recent: Berjaya Food 拟通过新合资公司重组 Kenny Rogers Roasters 业务，并认购该合资公司 5% 股权，交易完成后将失去对该业务的控制权。公司同时进行凭单行使带来的新股上市，并将在 12 月 7 日召开第 17 届常年股东大会。最新财报显示季度营收环比和同比均增长，但净亏损扩大。
notable: 拟通过新合资公司重组 Kenny Rogers Roasters 业务，并认购合资公司 5% 股权。
凭单行使后新股上市，涉及 5,715,000 股及 8,575,000 股。
将于 2026 年 12 月 7 日召开第 17 届常年股东大会。
risks: 最新季度净亏损扩大，净利率从上一季度的 -12.0% 降至 -49.7%。
董事在闭门期前表示有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 130.0 million，环比增长 9.1%，同比增长 12.2%；净亏损为 MYR 64.6 million，净利率为 -49.7%，上一季度为 -12.0%。

recent_en: Berjaya Food plans to restructure its Kenny Rogers Roasters business via a new joint venture company and subscribe for a 5% stake, ceding control of the business. The latest quarterly results show revenue growth both QoQ and YoY, but net loss widened.
notable_en: Proposes to restructure the Kenny Rogers Roasters business via a new joint venture company and subscribe for a 5% stake in the JVC.
New shares listed from warrant exercises involving 5,715,000 shares and 8,575,000 shares.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net loss widened, with net margin falling to -49.7% from -12.0% in the previous quarter.
A director indicated intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 130.0 million, up 9.1% QoQ and 12.2% YoY; net loss was MYR 64.6 million with a net margin of -49.7%, compared with -12.0% in the previous quarter.
